facts.text: The party must bring Warwick metal from the Dwarven mine north of Brandonsford, in exchange for the loan of his mithril chain shirt. Meanwhile Warwick keeps Sir Phidipaldi's lyre, playing it every night, and holds Sir Phidipaldi's plate armor as collateral.
The party must return Warwick's mithril chain shirt, his grandfather's armor, to him; in return Warwick gives back Sir Phidipaldi's plate armor and lyre.
Wayman Tisdale wears Warwick's mithril chain shirt, on loan, over his leather armor; it greatly improves his protection and halves the damage he takes from magic weapons and spells.
A natural-looking cave-in seals the Dwarven mine's entrance, blocking access to the metal for Warwick. It can be dug through, and Dunk has already bashed partway into it.
